description: Create complete AWS infrastructure-as-code in infra/ directory: CloudFormation template, Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, Nginx config, deploy scripts, and Portuguese README
steps: Create infra/ directory at the root of the repository
Create infra/cloudformation.yaml - CloudFormation template with 37 resources: VPC, subnets, IGW, NAT, route tables, ALB, ACM, EC2, RDS, Route53, Security Groups
Create infra/Dockerfile - Multi-stage build with separate runtime deps stage for flat node_modules
Create infra/runtime-deps.json - Standalone package.json for externalized runtime dependencies
Create infra/docker-compose.yml - api + nginx services with health checks
Create infra/nginx/nginx.conf - 3 server blocks for all domains
Create infra/.env.example - All env vars documented
acceptance_criteria: infra/ directory exists at repository root with all files - PASS
CloudFormation template is valid YAML with 37 resources - PASS
docker-compose.yml is valid with api + nginx services - PASS
nginx.conf handles all 3 domains correctly - PASS (syntax validated)
deploy.sh is executable with complete bootstrap logic - PASS
README.md is in Portuguese with step-by-step instructions - PASS
.env.example lists all required environment variables - PASS
Container starts and server listens on port 3000 - PASS

Docker image built successfully (3-stage: builder + deps + production)
Server starts and logs 'Server listening' on port 3000
All externalized packages resolve correctly (pg, drizzle-orm, express, @google-cloud/storage, etc.)

findings: pnpm's symlinked node_modules structure required a separate build stage with npm and a runtime-deps.json to create flat node_modules for the production container.
